PRICED BLOCKER ON FIRST SHIP

The exact merged reference-scope court passed 83/83. The current mandated premerge checker then failed for two mechanical reasons unrelated to that candidate: it parses Mote's `repositories:` metadata as a blocker, and it treats three already-reconciled historical first-parent commits as permanent failures.

Patch already exists: cand-2G3GBE7ZDZN0JP5YKD9869YDA0 / 79c0913d5df0353c8cb0224e38d7d76bea028a9d. It has Scout APPROVE and fresh chief evidence; authorization is its only blocker. I requested an active replacement authorizer at 11:09Z. On acceptance I will recut the identical checker tree on current main with that authorizer, gate and land it, then immediately rerun and land the 83/83 reference-scope slice. This gate repair is now the P0 shipping path.
